about_the_game:
SET IN THE WORLD OF GREMLINS, INC.


Welcome to the world of gremlins, the tiny creatures who love engineering as much as as they love money – a setting that's already familiar to the tabletop community from the award-winning digital board game Gremlins, Inc..

Greedy and malicious, these technocapitalists never stop planning and scheming. They are ready to lie, steal and outright attack their opponents as long as it helps them build their next big project.

EXECUTE A PLAN, WHILE STAYING OPEN FOR OPPORTUNITIES


With 6 cards in your hand and a deck of cards on the table, your goal is to earn the score by completing projects.

Execute a plan, while staying open for opportunities – if the right combination of action cards comes your way, or if your opponent disrupts your original blueprint.

DUELS IN SINGLE-PLAYER AND MULTIPLAYER MODES


When the game enters the Early Access period, it will be initially available in the duel mode – a human playing against the bot, or a human playing against another human. You can already play for score, for rounds, or for whatever comes first (a round limit, or a score goal).

As we continue to develop the project, we aim to add the opportunity to participate in sessions for more players – including team sessions.

PROVEN BY REAL-LIFE SESSIONS


Before we started to develop this game as a digital board game, it already existed as a real-life limited edition card game, which we premierred a few years ago at Gamescom. Since then, we've played over a hundred of sessions with different groups of people to fine-tune the concept. This digital version may be new, but the mechanics at its core are already tried and tested in real life, with great results.

JOIN A VIBRANT COMMUNITY


We release this game under the Early Access program. The game is already playable in its current state, but there are still things that we want to add (and features that we want to try).

Here on Steam Forums, as well as on the game's Discord server, we discuss the new mechanics and fine-tune the balance based on the feedback of the community. We aim to deliver a player experience that goes beyond the usual tabletop conversions. We invite you to join us on this mission to create a true digital board game!
